content: Yesu ꞌina toolo limana
Ta niꞌatu wiki ꞌana gimiꞌasiyata ꞌimai ga gonamapumapuya Meli Magidala ꞌimai ꞌaliꞌaliya ga ꞌana ꞌauboda gulewa ꞌiꞌitena ꞌaliꞌali ꞌawanega niꞌatu sipuli ilena.
ꞌEnega ꞌipili ga Yesu ꞌina tononoyao ꞌediya ꞌiona, ꞌigwae, “Niꞌatu ꞌInapwana siꞌewa apwesena ꞌaliꞌaliyega, ta mwaꞌo nai sisaꞌuna.” Tonono nidi Saimoni Pita be Yesu gosiya ꞌaiꞌailina.
ꞌEnega siteluwa nidi sitoolo ga sitauya ꞌaliꞌaliya,
ta ꞌidi tauya ꞌenaya sipilipili, ga Yesu gosiya ꞌaiꞌailina ꞌipili waiwai ga ꞌinugana ꞌaliꞌaliya,
ga ꞌaliꞌali ꞌena ꞌikopu sanalugu ga kaleko daisidimo ꞌiꞌitedi simiyami, ta nigeya ꞌilugulugu ꞌaliꞌali solanaya.
ꞌEnega Saimoni Pita wate mulinega ꞌipilima ga palupaluna ꞌilugu ꞌaliꞌali solanaya, ga tauna wate kaleko nidi ꞌeluwa ꞌiꞌitedi,
ꞌebweu debana ꞌana wadu ta wate oona maiboꞌana ꞌana wadu, ta debana ꞌana wadu nina tuwa tuga ꞌetamo paipaimina ꞌiꞌitena, tupwana ꞌimiya dumaduma oona ꞌana wadu ꞌenega.
Ta muliyega tai nina tauna ꞌaliꞌaliya ꞌigimiapwesa ꞌilugu Pita ꞌena, ga tauna wate kaleko nidi ꞌiꞌitedi ga ꞌiꞌawa ꞌaiꞌaila.
Ta esi nigeya sinuwanuwa sabwaleni Buki Tabu ꞌina simana nina ꞌigwae, ‘Toꞌetoseyana nina mwawasega ꞌida toolo limana.’
Gote ꞌenega tonono nidi siila ꞌidi anuwaya.
Yesu ꞌina apwesa Meli Magidala ꞌena
Ta Meli nina taunamo ꞌaliꞌali selabenaya ꞌitootoolo ta ꞌidedo, ꞌenega tuwa tuga ma ina dedoi ꞌaliꞌali nina ꞌena ꞌikopu sanalugu,
ga aniloseyao ꞌeluwa ꞌiꞌitedi, ꞌadi ꞌoamao wakewakekedi Yesu ꞌina ꞌebeꞌeno ꞌena simiyatowa, ꞌebweu debanega ta ꞌebweu ꞌaenega.
ꞌEnega siteluwa nidi Meli sieonena, sigwae, “Toꞌase manuna ꞌudedoi?” Ga ꞌieonedi, “ꞌIgu ꞌInapwana ꞌaliꞌaliyega siꞌewa apwesena ga nigeya yamwalamwalatoni mane ꞌena sisaꞌuna.”
Ta ꞌina ona gete mulinaya ꞌisanaila, ga Yesu ꞌiꞌitena selabenaya ꞌitootoolo, ta nigeya ꞌimwalamwalatoni ꞌaene tauna Yesu.

Ta Yesu Meli ꞌienaidena, ꞌigwae, “Waine, toꞌase manuna ꞌudedoi? Ta yaita ꞌuꞌebeꞌebese?” Ta Meli ꞌina nuwanuwa ꞌaene bagula nina ꞌana toꞌitaꞌiꞌita, ꞌenega ꞌena ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana, ꞌeguma ꞌoyo ꞌuꞌaala apwesena, ꞌuda eonagu mane ꞌena ꞌusaꞌuna, be yada ꞌewalima.”
ꞌEnega Yesu Meli ꞌana esana ꞌiꞌinanena, ꞌigwae, “Meli!” ta Meli ꞌisanasakowasi ga ꞌena ꞌigwae, “Labonai!” Me Yudia ꞌenadi nate ꞌana gibui “ꞌEnaꞌi.”

Ta Yesu wate ꞌieonena, ꞌigwae, “Geyaꞌabo ꞌugitogitoogu, manuna ꞌetamo nigeya yatuꞌetuꞌe Tamagu ꞌena. Ta ꞌutatauya be tasigwao ꞌueonadi ꞌaene ꞌaboꞌagu ꞌiabe yatutuꞌe Tamagu ꞌenaya, ꞌomi wate Tamami, ta ꞌigu Yaubada ta wate ꞌomi ꞌimi Yaubada.”
ꞌEnega Meli Magidala ꞌitauya ta tononoyao ꞌediya ꞌisimana, ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana niꞌatu yaꞌitena.” Ta wate Yesu ꞌina ona ꞌenaya ꞌisimana apwesedi tonono nidi ꞌediya.
Yesu ꞌina apwesa ꞌina tononoyao ꞌediya

Ta niꞌatu wiki ꞌana gimiꞌasiyata nina ꞌasuinuwanuwaya, Yesu ꞌina tononoyao anuwa ꞌebweu ꞌena silugu, ga ꞌawa sigibodena, ta solanaya simiyami, ma idi matauta me Yudia manudi. ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌimai ga gamwagamwanidiya ꞌitoolo, ga ꞌediya ꞌigwae, “Geyaꞌabo wamatamatauta.”
Ta muliyega nimana be lesulesuna ꞌieꞌitedi, ga tononoyao sigwausowala manuna ꞌidi ꞌInapwana niꞌatu siꞌitena.
Ta Yesu wate ꞌediya ꞌigwae, “Geyaꞌabo wamatamatauta. Tamagu tauna ꞌietuneguma, ta ꞌaboꞌagu wate nadigega yada etunemi.”
Ta ꞌina ona mulinaya ga yawasina ꞌimuꞌebalena ꞌediya ta wate ꞌediya ꞌiona, “Yaluyaluwa Tabuna waꞌewa,
be ꞌabo tomotai ꞌidi toꞌumalinao wanuwataudi Yaubada wate ꞌinuwataudi, ta ꞌeguma nigeya wanuwanuwataudi ꞌediya tuga sida miyami.”
Tomasi ꞌina ꞌawakabokabo

Ta Tomasi tauna ꞌebweuna tononoyao site tuwelo ꞌediyega, ta ꞌana esana ꞌeluwena Didiluwaluwa. Tomasi nina nigeya gosenao maꞌedi tuta nina Yesu ꞌimai. ꞌEnega muliyega Tomasi ꞌimai ga gosenao ꞌena sisimana, sigwae, “ꞌIda ꞌInapwana niꞌatu ꞌaꞌitena.”

Ga tauna ꞌiona, ꞌigwae, “Yee! Nate tuga kabo, ta esi ꞌaboꞌagu ꞌeguma nimana kainumuyega situtu epaꞌiyedi ꞌawaꞌiyaꞌiyaena yaꞌitadi be yagitoodi, ta wate lesulesunana sibadina ꞌena nimagu yasaꞌuluguyei, be ꞌenega yaemisemi.”

Ta niꞌatu wiki ꞌebweuna ꞌigumwala, ga wate tonono nidi anuwa nina ꞌena siegogona limana ga solanaya simiyami, Tomasi nina maꞌediya, ta ꞌawa sigibodedi. ꞌEnega Yesu wate ꞌiapwesa ga gamwagamwanidiya ꞌitoolo, ga ꞌediya ꞌigwae, “Geyaꞌabo wamatamatauta.”
Ta Tomasi ꞌena ꞌiona, “Gete nimagu, ꞌuꞌita, be nimayo ꞌuda saꞌudi weꞌiweꞌiyaya nidi ꞌediya, ta wate nimayo ꞌuda saꞌuluguye lesulesuguya, be ꞌenega ꞌuda emisegu, ta esi geyaꞌabo ꞌuꞌawaꞌawa kabokabo.”
ꞌEnega Tomasi ꞌigwae, “ꞌOyo ꞌigu ꞌInapwana ta ꞌigu Yaubada.”
Ta Yesu ꞌieonena, ꞌigwae, “Tomasi, niꞌatu ꞌuꞌitegu ꞌenega ꞌuemisegu, aga? Ta ꞌuda mwalatoni ꞌaene yaisigedi taudi nigeya siꞌitaꞌitagu ta tuwa tuga siemiemisegu, taudi tuta yauna ma idi gwausowala.”
Buki gete ꞌana ꞌetoladi manuna
Yesu niꞌatu weꞌiweꞌiyaya yaudi ꞌiguinuwedi ꞌana tomuliyao matadiya. Maiboꞌadi nigeya yaꞌetoꞌetoladidi buki gete ꞌena,
ta tuwa tuga puꞌepuꞌedimo yaꞌetoladidi be wada sawadi be wada mwalatoni be wate Yesu wada emise ꞌaene tauna Toꞌetoseyana nina, Yaubada natuna, be ꞌenega Yesu ꞌana esanega yawasimi ataya wada ꞌewa.
